notes.title: Major Update: Portuguese & Spanish Localization Now Available! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40204513/d96b31e69962a9e80c0f545979b10d4a8f6d166c.png[/img]

We’re excited to share some fantastic news: Back Then is now available in [b]Portuguese [/b]and [b]Spanish[/b]! 🇧🇷🇪🇸 Whether you’ve been waiting to experience the story in your native language or want to dive deeper into the emotional journey of Thomas Eilian, we’re thrilled to bring this update to you.

This major update includes:
📝 Full Portuguese and Spanish localization for subtitles and the user interface.
🐛 Some bug fixes.

Your feedback has been instrumental in making these improvements, and we can't thank you enough for your support.

If you notice any issues with the new localizations or encounter bugs, please don’t hesitate to let us know via the Steam discussions or by leaving a review.

Thank you for being part of this journey. We hope these updates enhance your experience with Back Then!

The Back Then Team 💙

notes.title: 🎉 Back Then Now Available on PlayStation! (+ OST Release!) 🎶
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=NB08HJJgkDk;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re thrilled to announce that Back Then is now officially available on PlayStation 5! 🎉
Experience Thomas Eilian’s journey with upgraded visuals, smooth performance, and localization in Portuguese and Spanish, letting you dive even deeper into his world. 

This milestone is paired with the release of our full [b]Official Soundtrack[/b], now on all major streaming platforms, including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, and Tidal! 🎶

[previewyoutube=rnebrY-0fiw;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been an incredible and long journey. In around 2 months, Back Then will be 6 years old. Of course, it only released last year for PC, and now for PlayStation. But the idea of this game originated first in January 2019, in a Global Game Jam. Little did I know how far we would've gotten. 
I (Calebe) was 19 years old then. I'm 25 now. A lot has happened since then, and time runs fast. Life is a flash. But "everything that has ever been done has led to you. Now. Here." Such is our story. 📖 

We dedicate this game to you, your families, and to all who were Back Then.

Thank you for supporting us, folks. We'll see you soon. ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40204513/24364898ce00b6906fa07dc5da4697bedc9596fb.gif[/img]

notes.title: Back Then - Update Released!
Back Then - Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cH23jt7OLvU;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! We're alive, and Back Then is getting closer and closer to the finish line. 

First, we have a new trailer, as you can see above! While we don't want to spoil much of the game, we can't wait for you all to explore and unravel this story we have been crafting. 

While we have no release date yet, we are still set to releasing later this year, and we can't wait for you all to play the game. Oh wait, you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40204513/850b339d023f10adf41cf5e51295455085e2e0d0.jpg[/img]

Back Then has a new demo available until the 25th of June!

In this demo, players can explore one of the sections of the game, with the story being narrated by Benjamin - the protagonist's youngest son, tormented by his neglect towards his father. We not only see Ben's perspective of the situation, but also the protagonist's, as we find ourselves placed in his shoes, wandering his home.

We hope you all enjoy, and don't forget to wishlist Back Then on Steam if you haven't already! 

Cheers,
The Outriders
